role: Shared regulated-language vocabulary: one Concept per regulated idea with latin (\b-wrapped) and unbounded (substring) alternatives in 17 locales; groups for the input guard (refuseAsRhythm/Emergency/GeneralConcern/Symptom/BeforeSending), the output guard (scrubFromOutput), the static-copy linter (neverInStaticCopy) and the sync gate (all), plus the cached regex compiler.
types: MedicalTermLexicon: enum — namespace of Concept constants and groups
MedicalTermLexicon.Concept: struct — id, latin, unbounded alternatives and combined pattern
toplevel: All content is static let Concept constants and [Concept] groups; refuseAsSymptom/refuseBeforeSending are unions read by MedicalQueryGuardTests and refuseBeforeSending/neverInStaticCopy are parsed by Tools/copy_linter/lint.py; scrubFromOutput is consumed by CoachVoiceGuard; all by tests and the perimeter sync gate. Apostrophes in the alternatives are written ['’] so model output and typed input with a typographic ’ match (can't breathe, m'inquiéter, d'une maladie, you're definitely, d'important); syncope matches 'faint' only as a verb form (fainted/faints/fainting/faintness) or after a feeling verb ('feel/felt/going to ... faint'), not the adjective ('a faint trace').

flags.text: DebugLogger.compiledPattern, which regex(for:) routes through, logs a compile failure as 'REDACTION PATTERN FAILED TO COMPILE — redaction is degraded', so a malformed medical-lexicon concept (silently dropped from the guard by compactMap) is reported as a redaction problem, misdirecting diagnosis.

units.does: Stores id, latin alternatives and unbounded alternatives (default empty).
Builds the concept regex source: \b(?:latin|...)\b when latin non-empty, plus (?:unbounded|...) when unbounded non-empty, joined as one alternation group.

branches.effect: true: add the word-bounded branch; false: omitted
true: add the bare substring branch; false: omitted (empty both gives "(?:)" which matches everything)

units.does: Compiles concept.pattern case-insensitively through DebugLogger.compiledPattern's process-wide cache; nil (with NSLog) when malformed.
